questionSnapshot.question: In Cinderella, at what time does the Fairy Godmother's spell wear off?

notes: Read all four answers and relevant full topic digests/category context; checked cross-bank matches, wording, scope, category and editorial difficulty. Challenged the glass slippers remaining magical: question asks the stated spell deadline, not whether every enchanted object vanishes. Dawn/noon/sunset do not match that deadline.

verification.context: In Cinderella, at what time does the Fairy Godmother's spell wear off?
